a.lede: Anthropic faces enormous compute commitments as it goes public, but its biggest infrastructure partners, including Amazon and Google, could continue profiting from AI even if Anthropic loses its lead.
a.title: Anthropic’s IPO puts AI’s circular financing boom to the test

b.title: Anthropic hits Nasdaq exchanges at $111, 33% above IPO price
